title: Guidelines for identifier normalization
content_data:
The following table outlines the guidelines for normalizing identifiers used to build audiences with the [Customer File API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739940501023746) or [Streaming API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739940504185857).
ID Type Required Header Description for Customer File Recommended Format
- Original Value		 Recommended Format
- Hashed		 Also supported
- Only Hashed		 Example 1
- Original Value		 Example 2
- Hashed
Email Email_SHA256
  • Remove spaces
  • All lowercase
  • Remove spaces
  • Convert all characters to lowercase
  • SHA-256 hashing required
 johndoe@gmail.com
  • Normalized: "janedoe@gmail.com"
  • Hashed: d6117306485ed0e50afab3ac871e98f81699151f30281527d63ff5f233656c69
Phone Phone_SHA256
  • E.164 format
  • "+"[country code][phone number]
  • E.164 format, "+"[country code][phone number]
  • SHA-256 hashing required
  • Without "+"
  • Without "+" and "country code"
  • US: +16577770000
  • INTL: +37493828222
  • Normalized:
    • US: +16577770000
    • INTL: +37493828222
  • Hashed: 65b7e6dcf6f4310f8d7cbfbd78289a753062fb054d6664fb9aaac5df66a422d4
MAID MAID or MAID_MD5 or MAID_SHA256
  • Use GAID (Android) or IDFA (iOS)
  • Case: all uppercase or all lowercase
  • Remove any spaces at the beginning or end
  • Case: all uppercase or all lowercase
  • Remove any spaces at the beginning or end
  • SHA-256 or MD5 hashing required
 aece52e7-03ee-455a-b3c4-e57283966239
  • Normalized: 5f3a2b18-9c4d-4e7f-b8e2-17d3a1e69b25
  • Hashed: 83dc3f5f32b9472613b0f038d36f22585a609d018af6f6067f50da318bf354bd
